programme.title: The Defiant Ones

programme.title: Maximum Overdrive
programme.desc: After a mysterious comet turns every machine on Earth into a homicidal rampage device, the survivors at the Dixie Boy Truck Stop are making a stand, and human vengeance goes into overdrive.

programme.title: Pet Sematary (1989)
programme.desc: For most families, moving is a new beginning. But for the Creeds, it could be the beginning of the end. Because they've just moved in next door to a place that children built with broken dreams, the Pet Sematary.

programme.title: Pet Sematary Two
programme.desc: Antagonized by the neighbourhood kids, Jeff befriends outsider, Drew Gilbert, who lives in fear of his cruel stepfather Gus. After Gus shoots Drew's beloved dog, the boys bury the body in a place rumoured to have powers of resurrection.

programme.title: Moonlight
programme.desc: A look at three defining chapters in the life of Chiron, a young Black man growing up in Miami. His epic journey to manhood is guided by the kindness, support, and love of the community that helps raise him.

programme.title: Zola
programme.desc: A waitress, strikes up a friendship with a customer, who seduces her to join a weekend in Florida. What seems like a glamorous trip transforms into a journey involving a pimp, a boyfriend, gangsters and adventures in this see-it-to-believe-it tale.

programme.title: The Last Black Man in San Francisco
programme.desc: Jimmie & his best friend Mont try to reclaim the home built by Jimmie's grandfather, launching them on a poignant odyssey that connects them to their past, even as it tests their friendship & sense of belonging in the place they call home.

programme.title: Treasure of Bruce Lee
programme.desc: Master Chen has four pupils, each of which he has taught a different style of kung fu based on their abilities. The secret book of Chinese Kung Fu styles is kept safe by the master.

programme.title: Bruce Lee and Kung-Fu Mania
programme.desc: Action highlights, featurettes, & original grindhouse trailers from 40 of the greatest martial arts films of the 70's. This kung-fu-fighting, karate-kicking compilation features the real Bruce Lee & his many clones.

programme.title: Bruce's Fists Of Vengeance
programme.desc: Jack flies into Manila from Hong Kong and brings along a book of secrets.

programme.title: School of Rock
programme.desc: Jack Black stars as a guitarist with delusions of grandeur. Kicked out of his band and looking for work, he becomes a substitute teacher and turns his class into rock and rollers.

programme.title: Erik the Viking
programme.desc: A Monty Pythonesque farce about a Viking who grows dissatisfied with his barbaric way of life, and decides to set out to find the mythical Asgard--where the Norse gods dwell.

programme.title: National Lampoon's Vacation
programme.desc: The all-American Griswold family wants to go on an all-American vacation. Everyone gets packed, the route gets planned, and absolutely everything goes wrong. A simple trip becomes a madcap cross-country odyssey in search of recreation.

programme.title: Flashdance
programme.desc: The visual and musical box-office smash Flashdance is the exhilarating story of Alex Owens (Jennifer Beals), a fiercely determined and beautiful 18-year-old woman, who works as a welder by day and a dancer at a local bar at night.

programme.title: She's Having a Baby
programme.desc: Last year at this time, Jake and Kristi were two crazy single kids in love. Now they're two crazy married adults in transition.

programme.title: Some Kind of Wonderful (1987)
programme.desc: In this story from legendary filmmaker John Hughes, Keith, Watts and Amanda prove that you've got to risk a broken heart in order to find your one true love. This unforgettable romantic comedy has laughs, romance and is truly Some Kind of Wonderful.

programme.title: Memento
programme.desc: A man with short-term memory loss attempts to track down his wife's murderer.

programme.title: Hannibal
programme.desc: Dr. Hannibal Lecter (Anthony Hopkins) comes out of hiding to draw FBI Agent Clarice Starling (Julianne Moore) into a high-stakes battle that tests her strength, cunning...and loyalty. Gary Oldman, Ray Liotta and Giancarlo Giannini also star.

programme.title: Pacific Heights
programme.desc: A couple work hard to renovate their dream house and become landlords to pay for it. Unfortunately, one of their tenants has plans of his own.

programme.title: Hotel Rwanda
programme.desc: The film chronicles the true story of Paul Rusesabinga (Don Cheadle), a brave hotel manager who risked his life and those of his family to take in more than 1,000 refugees during the 1994 genocide of the Tutsus by Hutu militia.

programme.title: Hoosiers
programme.desc: A man gets a last-chance job coaching a small-town Indiana high-school basketball team and faces the dual challenge of bringing this underdog team to the 1951 state championship and redeeming himself from a mysterious past.

programme.title: The Fighter
programme.desc: Based on a true story, two brothers, against all the odds, come together to train for a historic title bout that has the power to reunite their fractured family and give their hard-luck town what it's been waiting for: pride.

programme.title: The Conspirator
programme.desc: From director Robert Redford comes the riveting true story behind the assassination trial of Abraham Lincoln – including the lone woman who was accused of plotting his murder.

programme.title: Jericho
programme.desc: Amnesiac gunman Jericho is rescued and befriended by a charismatic and itinerant cowboy/preacher named Joshua. Together they survive certain danger, while Jericho searches to find the answer to his lost identity.

programme.title: American Outlaws
programme.desc: When a Midwest town learns that a corrupt railroad baron has captured the deeds to their homesteads without their knowledge, young ranchers join forces to take back what is rightfully theirs.

programme.title: South of Heaven, West of Hell
programme.desc: A small-town marshal, tormented by the puzzling conditions that surround him, is forced to confront his demons at an unexpected and untraditional 'family reunion'.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark
programme.desc: Get ready for thrills in Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark. Indy and his ex-flame Marion Ravenwood dodge booby-traps, fight Nazis, and stare down snakes in their incredible worldwide quest for the mystical Ark of the Covenant.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
programme.desc: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom brings you thrills and excitement. Indy, his sidekick Short Round and nightclub singer Willie Scott go from high-flying action above the Himalayas to a spine-tingling escape from a fortress-like mine in India.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
programme.desc: There's nothing more exciting than trying to keep up with the Joneses in Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade. Indy's Nazi enemies are back and have kidnapped his father, in their effort to locate the sacred Holy Grail.

programme.title: Everything Everywhere All at Once
programme.desc: When an interdimensional rupture unravels reality, an unlikely hero (Michelle Yeoh) must channel her newfound powers to fight bizarre and bewildering dangers from the multiverse as the fate of everything hangs in the balance.

programme.title: Ferris Bueller's Day Off
programme.desc: High school senior, Ferris Bueller, decides to cut school and is determined to experience a day of pure freedom with his girlfriend and best friend in downtown Chicago before graduating.

programme.title: Kingpin
programme.desc: A star bowler whose career was prematurely "cut off" hopes to ride a new prodigy to success and riches.

programme.title: Mommie Dearest
programme.desc: The public Crawford was strong-willed, glamorous and admirable, but Mommie Dearest reveals the private Crawford, the woman desperate to be a mother, adopting her children when she was single and trying to survive in the devastating movie industry.

programme.title: Desperately Seeking Susan
programme.desc: A bored New Jersey suburban housewife's fascination with a kooky character she's read about in the personal columns leads to her being mistaken for the woman herself.

programme.title: Earth Girls Are Easy
programme.desc: Three aliens (Jim Carrey, Damon Wayans, and Jeff Goldblum) crash-land in Los Angeles' San Fernando Valley. A manicurist (Geena Davis) and her boss (the wacky Julie Brown) befriend the threesome, give them makeovers and show them the town.

programme.title: The Little Mermaid
programme.desc: Beauty is both deceiving and dangerous in this dark twist on Hans Christian Andersen's classic tale, as an underwater discovery draws an innocent man into a mermaid's evil world.

programme.title: Benny Loves You
programme.desc: When a man desperate to start a new life throws away his childhood plush, Benny, it's a move that can only end in death.

programme.title: Winnie-the-Pooh: Blood and Honey
programme.desc: Winnie-The-Pooh: Blood and Honey follows Pooh and Piglet as they go on a rampage after Christopher Robin abandons them.

programme.title: Rain Man
programme.desc: Tom Cruise stars as an idealistic young wheeler-dealer whose life is changed forever when he discovers he has an autistic savant older brother (Dustin Hoffman, in a Best Actor Oscar-winning performance).

programme.title: The Untouchables
programme.desc: This confrontation between good and evil stars Kevin Costner as federal agent Eliot Ness, Robert De Niro as gangland kingpin Al Capone, and Sean Connery as Malone, the cop who teaches Ness how to beat the mob: shoot fast and shoot first.

programme.title: A Fish Called Wanda (1988)
programme.desc: Kevin Kline won the Best Supporting Actor Oscar for his role in this wildly popular comedy about an intricate diamond heist that's peppered with the comical antics of Jamie Lee Curtis and John Cleese.

programme.title: Infinite
programme.desc: Evan McCauley has skills he never learned and memories of places he has never visited. Self-medicated and on the brink of a mental breakdown, a secret group that call themselves Infinites come to his rescue, revealing that his memories are real.

programme.title: Arrival
programme.desc: When mysterious spacecraft touch down across the globe, an elite team - led by expert translator Louise Banks (Academy Award® nominee Amy Adams) – races against time to decipher their intent.

programme.title: Disturbia
programme.desc: Living under three months' house arrest, Kale Brecht (Shia LaBeouf, Transformers) passes his days spying on the neighbors. It's all fun and games until things take a horrifying turn for the worse.

programme.title: The Wolf of Wall Street
programme.desc: Sex. Money. Power. Drugs. Brace yourself for a true story from legendary filmmaker Martin Scorsese. Leonardo DiCaprio stars as a young stockbroker hungry for a life of non-stop thrills, where corruption was king and more was never enough.

programme.title: The Boondock Saints
programme.desc: Two Irish Catholic brothers become vigilantes and wipe out Boston's criminal underworld in the name of God.

programme.title: Cop Land
programme.desc: Director James Mangold (FORD vs FERRARI) extends his crime thriller classic that brings together a powerhouse cast, including Robert De Niro, Sylvester Stallone, Ray Liotta, and Harvey Keitel.

programme.title: Killer Elite
programme.desc: A special-ops agent must rescue his mentor.

programme.title: Lucky Number Slevin
programme.desc: A case of mistaken identity lands Slevin into the middle of a war being plotted by two of the city's most rival crime bosses: The Rabbi and The Boss.

programme.title: The Matador
programme.desc: A globetrotting hitman and a salesman form an unlikely relationship after meeting at a hotel bar in Mexico City.

programme.title: Road to Perdition
programme.desc: Bonds of loyalty are put to the test when a hitman's son witnesses what his father does for a living.

programme.title: Flatliners
programme.desc: Are you afraid to die? Kiefer Sutherland isn't. He's an ambitious, charismatic medical student who persuades classmates Julia Roberts and Kevin Bacon to take part in a reckless experiment. Rated: R

programme.title: The Fisher King
programme.desc: Parry, a homeless history professor, lives in a fantasy world full of castles, Red Knights and damsels in distress. Bridges co-stars as Jack, New York's #1 shock deejay, whose off-hand arrogance triggers a tragedy which ruins his career. Rated: R

programme.title: Regarding Henry
programme.desc: Henry Turner is a New York lawyer who needs to win at any cost. But a single gunshot brings Henry’s fast-track rise to a dead stop, leaving him incapacitated and with no memory of the life he used to lead.

programme.title: Grease 2
programme.desc: Return to rockin’ Rydell High for a whole new term! It’s 1961, two years after the original "Grease" gang graduated, and there’s a new crop of seniors – and new members of the coolest cliques on campus.

programme.title: Rockers
programme.desc: Night Flight Presents: Starring Leroy 'Horsemouth' Wallace and Richard 'Dirty Harry' Hall; ROCKERS is a story of oppressed Jamaican musicians getting even with the 'mafia types' in the business

programme.title: Boy in the Plastic Bubble
programme.desc: The girl next door makes a teen (John Travolta) born with immune deficiencies want to leave his germ-free bubble.

programme.title: Grease
programme.desc: Grease is the one that you want! Go back to high school with Pink Lady Sandy (Olivia Newton-John), leader of the bad-boy T-Birds, Danny (John Travolta), and a rockin' and rollin' all-star cast.

programme.title: Mad Max
programme.desc: Max and the gang's worlds converge when the gang wants Max as badly as he wants them, especially after they target him for the death of their former leader.

programme.title: Ex Machina

programme.title: Revolutionary Road
programme.desc: This mesmerizing and moving story follows the lives of a young couple living in suburban Connecticut who decide to risk everything to pursue their dreams.

programme.title: Catch Me If You Can
programme.desc: From three-time Oscar-winning director Steven Spielberg, Catch Me If You Can follows Frank W. Abagnale, Jr. as he successfully passes himself off as a pilot, a lawyer, and a doctor - all before his 21st birthday!

programme.title: The Aviator
programme.desc: The early years of larger-than-life American figure Howard Hughes are captured by legendary director Martin Scorsese, in this acclaimed Oscar-winning biopic starring Leonardo DiCaprio and Cate Blanchett.

programme.title: Regression
programme.desc: A detective (Ethan Hawke) and a psychoanalyst (David Thewlis) uncover evidence of a satanic cult while investigating the rape of a traumatized teen (Emma Watson).

programme.title: Mindcage
programme.desc: When a copycat murderer strikes, Detectives Jake Doyle and Mary Kelly seek help from an incarcerated serial killer named the Artist. As Mary delves deep into the Artist's twisted psyche, she and Jake get lured into a diabolical game of cat and mouse.

programme.title: Manhunter
programme.desc: An ex-FBI sleuth (William Petersen) returns to psych out a full-moon ritual killer as only he can.

programme.title: Allied

programme.title: The Mexican
programme.desc: A man tries to transport an ancient gun called The Mexican, believed to carry a curse, back across the border, while his girlfriend pressures him to give up his criminal ways.

programme.title: The Curious Case of Benjamin Button
programme.desc: Brad Pitt and Cate Blanchett star in the adaption of F. Scott Fitzgerald's story about an elderly man who ages backward and the problems that arise when he falls in love with a woman.

programme.title: Bill & Ted's Excellent Adventure
programme.desc: Our non-heinous heroes Bill (Alex Winter) and Ted (Keanu Reeves) are in danger of flunking history! But when the righteous Rufus (George Carlin) arrives in a time-travelling phone booth, the dense dudes discover their destiny!

programme.title: The Great Escape
programme.desc: Steve McQueen, James Garner, and Richard Attenborough headline a stellar cast in one of the most ingenious and suspenseful adventure films of all time as a team of Allied soldiers mount a daring escape from an inescapable Nazi POW camp.

programme.title: Stalag 17
programme.desc: Laced with comedy and cynicism, this is the story of a group of GIs who are thrown together in the notorious German prison camp Stalag 17, their suspicions about one being a spy and their efforts to escape.

programme.title: London Has Fallen
programme.desc: In London for the Prime Minister's funeral, Mike Banning is caught up in a plot to assassinate all the attending world leaders.

programme.title: Revolver
programme.desc: REVOLVER is populated with Guy Ritchie's (Snatch; Lock, Stock & Two Smoking Barrels) classic breed of fast-talking, sharp-suited gangsters but with a psychological twist that your mind may not be able to handle.

programme.title: Parker
programme.desc: Parker is a thief who lives by a personal code of ethics: Don't steal from people who can't afford it and don't hurt people who don't deserve it. But on his latest heist, his crew double-crosses him, steals his stash, and leaves him for dead.

programme.title: Pet Sematary Two
programme.desc: Antagonized by the neighbourhood kids, Jeff befriends outsider, Drew Gilbert, who lives in fear of his cruel stepfather Gus. After Gus shoots Drew's beloved dog, the boys bury the body in a place rumoured to have powers of resurrection.

programme.title: Carrie (2013)
programme.desc: Chloë Grace Moretz and Julianne Moore star in this exhilarating reimagining of Stephen King's iconic best-seller, 'Carrie.' After merciless taunting and abuse, events spiral out of control until the terrifying conclusion of this horror story.

programme.title: Let Me In
programme.desc: Owen, an overlooked and bullied boy, finds love and revenge through Abby (Chloë Grace Moretz of KICK-ASS), a beautiful but peculiar girl who turns out to be a vampire.

programme.title: The Last Black Man in San Francisco
programme.desc: Jimmie & his best friend Mont try to reclaim the home built by Jimmie's grandfather, launching them on a poignant odyssey that connects them to their past, even as it tests their friendship & sense of belonging in the place they call home.

programme.title: Moonlight
programme.desc: A look at three defining chapters in the life of Chiron, a young Black man growing up in Miami. His epic journey to manhood is guided by the kindness, support, and love of the community that helps raise him.

programme.title: Zola
programme.desc: A waitress, strikes up a friendship with a customer, who seduces her to join a weekend in Florida. What seems like a glamorous trip transforms into a journey involving a pimp, a boyfriend, gangsters and adventures in this see-it-to-believe-it tale.

programme.title: Bruce's Fists Of Vengeance
programme.desc: Jack flies into Manila from Hong Kong and brings along a book of secrets.

programme.title: Goodbye Bruce Lee
programme.desc: A kung fu expert is approached by the director of the late Bruce Lee's unfinished film and asked to help in bringing the film to the silver screen.

programme.title: Bruce Lee: His Last Days, His Last Nights
programme.desc: The story of action star Bruce Lee's life in the days leading up to untimely death.

programme.title: National Lampoon's Vacation
programme.desc: The all-American Griswold family wants to go on an all-American vacation. Everyone gets packed, the route gets planned, and absolutely everything goes wrong. A simple trip becomes a madcap cross-country odyssey in search of recreation.

programme.title: National Lampoon's European Vacation
programme.desc: The first time the all-American Griswold family ventured forth, in National Lampoon's Vacation, it was just a domestic outing. This time, they take on the Continent--all in a catastrophe-filled fortnight--thanks to a TV quiz-show grand prize.

programme.title: Hook
programme.desc: Superstars Robin Williams, Dustin Hoffman and Julia Roberts star in award-winning director Steve Spielberg's updating of PETER PAN.

programme.title: Some Kind of Wonderful (1987)
programme.desc: In this story from legendary filmmaker John Hughes, Keith, Watts and Amanda prove that you've got to risk a broken heart in order to find your one true love. This unforgettable romantic comedy has laughs, romance and is truly Some Kind of Wonderful.

programme.title: Heartburn
programme.desc: She's a magazine writer who gives up her career for love and family. He's a playboy newspaper columnist who can't quite give up his old tricks. And if that combination doesn't give a relationship Heartburn, nothing will!

programme.title: Footloose
programme.desc: A rebellious city boy finds himself in an uptight Midwestern town where dancing and therefore all youthful joy has been banned.

programme.title: Hannibal
programme.desc: Dr. Hannibal Lecter (Anthony Hopkins) comes out of hiding to draw FBI Agent Clarice Starling (Julianne Moore) into a high-stakes battle that tests her strength, cunning...and loyalty. Gary Oldman, Ray Liotta and Giancarlo Giannini also star.

programme.title: Pacific Heights
programme.desc: A couple work hard to renovate their dream house and become landlords to pay for it. Unfortunately, one of their tenants has plans of his own.

programme.title: Jack Reacher
programme.desc: Investigator Jack Reacher leaps off the pages of Lee Child's novel and onto the big screen in this thriller. When a horrible crime is committed, all evidence points to the suspect in custody, who offers up a single note in defense: "Get Jack Reacher!"

programme.title: Hoosiers
programme.desc: A man gets a last-chance job coaching a small-town Indiana high-school basketball team and faces the dual challenge of bringing this underdog team to the 1951 state championship and redeeming himself from a mysterious past.

programme.title: The Fighter
programme.desc: Based on a true story, two brothers, against all the odds, come together to train for a historic title bout that has the power to reunite their fractured family and give their hard-luck town what it's been waiting for: pride.

programme.title: Good Will Hunting
programme.desc: The hit Oscar-winning drama which launched the careers of Matt Damon and Ben Affleck tells the tale of a headstrong, working-class genius who's failing the lessons of life, until he meets a relatable psychology professor (Robin Williams).

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: A high-school boy is given the chance to write a story for Rolling Stone Magazine about an up-and-coming rock band as he accompanies it on their concert tour.

programme.title: American Outlaws
programme.desc: When a Midwest town learns that a corrupt railroad baron has captured the deeds to their homesteads without their knowledge, young ranchers join forces to take back what is rightfully theirs.

programme.title: South of Heaven, West of Hell
programme.desc: A small-town marshal, tormented by the puzzling conditions that surround him, is forced to confront his demons at an unexpected and untraditional 'family reunion'.

programme.title: Grey Owl
programme.desc: The story of the life and work of the Canadian fur trapper-turned-conservationist who claimed to be an aboriginal North American.

programme.title: Geronimo: An American Legend
programme.desc: An American legend comes to life in this epic Western starring Jason Patric, Robert Duvall, Gene Hackman and Wes Studi as Geronimo, giving a stunning performance as the fearless warrior who was the last Indian leader to surrender to the white man.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
programme.desc: There's nothing more exciting than trying to keep up with the Joneses in Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade. Indy's Nazi enemies are back and have kidnapped his father, in their effort to locate the sacred Holy Grail.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
programme.desc: STEVEN SPIELBERG and GEORGE LUCAS bring you the greatest adventurer of all time! Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull finds Indy trying to outrace a brilliant and beautiful agent for the mystical, all-powerful crystal skull of Akator.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark
programme.desc: Get ready for thrills in Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark. Indy and his ex-flame Marion Ravenwood dodge booby-traps, fight Nazis, and stare down snakes in their incredible worldwide quest for the mystical Ark of the Covenant.

programme.title: Ferris Bueller's Day Off
programme.desc: High school senior, Ferris Bueller, decides to cut school and is determined to experience a day of pure freedom with his girlfriend and best friend in downtown Chicago before graduating.

programme.title: Kingpin
programme.desc: A star bowler whose career was prematurely "cut off" hopes to ride a new prodigy to success and riches.

programme.title: RV (2006)
programme.desc: A forced family vacation in a recreational vehicle rapidly turns into a disaster.

programme.title: Earth Girls Are Easy
programme.desc: Three aliens (Jim Carrey, Damon Wayans, and Jeff Goldblum) crash-land in Los Angeles' San Fernando Valley. A manicurist (Geena Davis) and her boss (the wacky Julie Brown) befriend the threesome, give them makeovers and show them the town.

programme.title: Fatal Attraction
programme.desc: Michael Douglas plays Dan, a New York attorney who has a tryst with seductive Alex Forrest while his wife is away. Dan later shrugs off the affair as a mistake and considers it over. But Alex won't be ignored. Not now, not tomorrow, not ever.

programme.title: Heathers
programme.desc: Winona Ryder, Christian Slater, and Shannen Doherty star in this cruelly hilarious dark comedy, which became one of the biggest cult classics of the `80s.

programme.title: Winnie-the-Pooh: Blood and Honey
programme.desc: Winnie-The-Pooh: Blood and Honey follows Pooh and Piglet as they go on a rampage after Christopher Robin abandons them.

programme.title: The Little Mermaid
programme.desc: Beauty is both deceiving and dangerous in this dark twist on Hans Christian Andersen's classic tale, as an underwater discovery draws an innocent man into a mermaid's evil world.

programme.title: My Bloody Valentine
programme.desc: A remake of George Mihalka's 1981 classic slasher film, MY BLOODY VALENTINE takes place ten years after a devastating coal mining accident when a string of gruesome murders plagues a town.

programme.title: A Fish Called Wanda (1988)
programme.desc: Kevin Kline won the Best Supporting Actor Oscar for his role in this wildly popular comedy about an intricate diamond heist that's peppered with the comical antics of Jamie Lee Curtis and John Cleese.

programme.title: The January Man
programme.desc: A killer comedy that has an ex-cop trailing a serial murderer... and the mayor's sexy daughter! Kevin Kline leads an all-star cast that includes Susan Sarandon, Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio, Harvey Keitel and Rod Steiger.

programme.title: Miami Blues
programme.desc: An ex-con (Alec Baldwin) tiptoes on the borderline of psychotic behavior, playing cops and robbers on both sides of the law. He robs and kills one minute and poses as a cop the next in this thriller with a comic edge.

programme.title: Arrival
programme.desc: When mysterious spacecraft touch down across the globe, an elite team - led by expert translator Louise Banks (Academy Award® nominee Amy Adams) – races against time to decipher their intent.

programme.title: Disturbia
programme.desc: Living under three months' house arrest, Kale Brecht (Shia LaBeouf, Transformers) passes his days spying on the neighbors. It's all fun and games until things take a horrifying turn for the worse.

programme.title: The Italian Job (2003)
programme.desc: The plan was flawless. The execution was perfect. Charlie Croker pulled off the crime of a lifetime. The one thing that he didn't plan on was being double-crossed.

programme.title: The Boondock Saints
programme.desc: Two Irish Catholic brothers become vigilantes and wipe out Boston's criminal underworld in the name of God.

programme.title: Cop Land

programme.title: The Bridges at Toko-Ri
programme.desc: This masterful story of a war-weary World War II veteran who must leave his family to fight again combines moving drama with surefire, bombs-away aerial action. Also starring Grace Kelly as his loving, luminescent wife.

programme.title: Paris When It Sizzles
programme.desc: Richard Quine directs George Axelrod's acerbic script (adapted from Julien Duvivier's La Fête à Henriette) in this romantic comedy that reunites William Holden and Audrey Hepburn for the first time since 1954's Sabrina.

programme.title: The Children's Hour (1962)
programme.desc: In this provocatively daring film, an attention-seeking schoolgirl vengefully spreads rumors that her teachers (Audrey Hepburn and Shirley MacLaine) are lesbians.

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: A man robbed of his name and his dignity strives to win them back, and gain the freedom of his people, in this epic historical drama from director Ridley Scott.

programme.title: Tears of the Sun
programme.desc: After a West African president's family is assassinated and civil unrest is rampant, a top-secret team is deployed to the far reaches of the jungle to rescue a U.S. doctor who is acting as a missionary.

programme.title: 13 Hours: The Secret Soldiers of Benghazi
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay, 13 HOURS is the gripping true story of six elite ex-military operators assigned to protect the CIA who fought back against overwhelming odds when terrorists attacked a U.S. diplomatic compound on September 11, 2012.

programme.title: Hush
programme.desc: A deaf and mute writer who retreated into the woods to live a solitary life must fight for her life in silence when a masked killer appears at her window.

programme.title: The Eye
programme.desc: A blind girl receives a cornea transplant so that she is able to see again. However, she gets more than she bargains for when she realizes she can see disturbing ghosts.

programme.title: What Lies Beneath
programme.desc: The wife of a professor investigates the murder of a beautiful college student who has been appearing to her.

programme.title: In Too Deep
programme.desc: Officer Cole is assigned to infiltrate the syndicate of God, a deadly crime lord. But as Cole sinks deeper into God's crew, he begins to get in over his head, until the line that separates his true identity from his street persona begins to disappear.

programme.title: Four Brothers
programme.desc: After their adoptive mother is murdered during a grocery store hold-up, the Mercer bros reunite to take the matter into their own hands. As they track down the killer, they quickly realize that their old ways of doing business have new consequences.

programme.title: Drop Zone
programme.desc: Wesley Snipes free-falls into the daredevil world of sky-diving to track down a cadre of techno terrorists in Drop Zone, a chute-to-thrill adventure co-starring Gary Busey, Yancy Butler, Michael Jeter and more.

programme.title: Enter The Panther
programme.desc: A young kung fu master seeks vengeance upon the villains.

programme.title: Return of the Chinese Boxer
programme.desc: In wake of the First Sino-Japanese War (1894-1895), a group of Japanese warlords calculate the best way to prepare an invasion of the rest of China is from their southern Manchuria staging ground.

programme.title: Lady Snowblood
programme.desc: A young woman is trained from birth to be a deadly instrument of revenge against the swindlers who destroyed her family.

programme.title: National Lampoon's European Vacation
programme.desc: The first time the all-American Griswold family ventured forth, in National Lampoon's Vacation, it was just a domestic outing. This time, they take on the Continent--all in a catastrophe-filled fortnight--thanks to a TV quiz-show grand prize.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective
programme.desc: Ace Ventura Pet Detective is on the case to find the Miami Dolphins' missing mascot and quarterback Dan Marino. He goes eye to eye with sharks, stakes out the Miami Dolphins and woos and wows the ladies. He always gets his man...or beast.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls
programme.desc: Africa's the place where Ace is on the case, setting out to rescue an animal he loathes - a bat! If you're ready to laugh like a pack of hyenas, if you want more fun than an industrial-sized barrel of monkeys, you'll know what to do. Heed the call.

programme.title: Best Men
programme.desc: Drew Barrymore, Luke Wilson and Sean Patrick Flannery star in this hilarious action-comedy wherein Drew Barrymore is a young woman determined to have the perfect wedding day, despite the fact that the groomsmen have decided to rob the local bank.

programme.title: At First Sight
programme.desc: AT FIRST SIGHT is the story of a young woman architect who falls in love with a blind man. She encourages him to undergo a radical operation to restore his sight, but ultimately his truest vision comes from the love he finds in his heart.

programme.title: Autumn In New York
programme.desc: Autumn in New York follows the sexual exploits of Will Keane (RICHARD GERE) until he runs into an unexpected dead end when he meets Charlotte Fielding (WINONA RYDER). Charlotte is half Will's age and twice his match.

programme.title: Angels & Demons
programme.desc: Expert symbologist Robert Langdon (Tom Hanks) follows ancient clues on a heart-racing hunt through Rome to find the four Cardinals kidnapped by the deadly secret society, the Illuminati.

programme.title: Inferno
programme.desc: Robert Langdon (Tom Hanks) follows a trail of clues across Europe with Sienna Brooks (Felicity Jones) to stop a virus that would wipe out half the world’s population.

programme.title: Jack Reacher
programme.desc: Investigator Jack Reacher leaps off the pages of Lee Child's novel and onto the big screen in this thriller. When a horrible crime is committed, all evidence points to the suspect in custody, who offers up a single note in defense: "Get Jack Reacher!"

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: A high-school boy is given the chance to write a story for Rolling Stone Magazine about an up-and-coming rock band as he accompanies it on their concert tour.

programme.title: Forrest Gump
programme.desc: Tom Hanks gives an astonishing performance as Forrest, an everyman whose simple innocence comes to embody a generation.

programme.title: The Fighter
programme.desc: Based on a true story, two brothers, against all the odds, come together to train for a historic title bout that has the power to reunite their fractured family and give their hard-luck town what it's been waiting for: pride.

programme.title: Eddie and the Cruisers
programme.desc: A reporter begins tracking down rumors of an unreleased album by a rock band whose charismatic leader disappeared after an accident and was presumed dead years before.

programme.title: Geronimo: An American Legend
programme.desc: An American legend comes to life in this epic Western starring Jason Patric, Robert Duvall, Gene Hackman and Wes Studi as Geronimo, giving a stunning performance as the fearless warrior who was the last Indian leader to surrender to the white man.

programme.title: Red Headed Stranger
programme.desc: Revisionist western about fallen preacher Shay, who guns down his wife Raysha for running off with another man. Wandering, he meets single mom Laurie. However, helpless sheriff Scoby wants Shay to help him fight the villainous Clavers.

programme.title: Posse
programme.desc: There's action galore in this off-beat western that features a group of mostly black infantrymen who return from the Spanish-American War with a cache of gold. The men travel to the West where their leader searches for the men who lynched his father.

programme.title: Quigley Down Under
programme.desc: A self-assured American sharpshooter moves to Australia in search of employment and finds work for a despotic land baron in the Australian outback.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
programme.desc: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom brings you thrills and excitement. Indy, his sidekick Short Round and nightclub singer Willie Scott go from high-flying action above the Himalayas to a spine-tingling escape from a fortress-like mine in India.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
programme.desc: There's nothing more exciting than trying to keep up with the Joneses in Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade. Indy's Nazi enemies are back and have kidnapped his father, in their effort to locate the sacred Holy Grail.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
programme.desc: STEVEN SPIELBERG and GEORGE LUCAS bring you the greatest adventurer of all time! Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull finds Indy trying to outrace a brilliant and beautiful agent for the mystical, all-powerful crystal skull of Akator.

programme.title: Kingpin
programme.desc: A star bowler whose career was prematurely "cut off" hopes to ride a new prodigy to success and riches.

programme.title: Everything Everywhere All at Once
programme.desc: When an interdimensional rupture unravels reality, an unlikely hero (Michelle Yeoh) must channel her newfound powers to fight bizarre and bewildering dangers from the multiverse as the fate of everything hangs in the balance.

programme.title: The Italian Job (2003)
programme.desc: The plan was flawless. The execution was perfect. Charlie Croker pulled off the crime of a lifetime. The one thing that he didn't plan on was being double-crossed.

programme.title: Bad Boys
programme.desc: Academy Award winner Sean Penn's breakthrough dramatic performance.

programme.title: Point Break
programme.desc: An F.B.I. Agent goes undercover to catch a gang of surfers who may be bank robbers.

programme.title: King of New York
programme.desc: Recently freed from prison, Frank White (Christopher Walken) begins to exterminate the drug lords who rose to power in his absence. When a group of enraged cops declares war on him, Frank's answer is to put a contract out on the cops.

programme.title: State Property
programme.desc: Beans decides that the only way to grasp the American Dream is to take it. STATE PROPERTY follows Beans and his crew, as they take over the city creating mayhem as their empire builds.

programme.title: Terrifier 2
programme.desc: After being resurrected by a sinister entity, Art the Clown returns to Miles County where he begins to target a teenage girl and her younger brother on Halloween.

programme.title: Terrifier 3
programme.desc: Art the Clown is set to unleash chaos on the unsuspecting residents of Miles County as they peacefully drift off to sleep on Christmas Eve.

programme.title: You're Next
programme.desc: The Davisons' family reunion goes awry when their home comes under siege by a mask-wearing team of crossbow-bearing assailants.

programme.title: Black Rain
programme.desc: Academy Award-winner Michael Douglas and Andy Garcia play New York cops whose job to escort an assassin back to his native Japan leads the two Americans into Osaka's underworld and straight into the center of a raging battle.

programme.title: At Close Range
programme.desc: A son wants to be like his father and earn himself a place in the family crime syndicate. Together with his brother, he forms his own gang to gain his dad's respect. Efforts backfire as the father fears that he is losing control.

programme.title: Colors
programme.desc: As members of the Los Angeles Police Department's elite anti-gang unit, a veteran cop and his new partner are called in to assist with the crackdown against the mounting gang violence in the barrios and slums of East Los Angeles.

programme.title: Deep Impact
programme.desc: When a couple of young astronomers discover an enormous comet on course to collide with Earth, the countdown to doomsday begins, and the human race embarks on the fight for survival.

programme.title: Congo
programme.desc: When an expedition to the African Congo ends in disaster, a new team is assembled to find out what went wrong.

programme.title: The Time Machine
programme.desc: Hoping to alter the events of the past, a 19th-century inventor instead travels 800,000 years into the future, where he finds humankind divided into two warring races.

programme.title: Super 8
programme.desc: In the summer of 1979, a group of friends in a small Ohio town witness a catastrophic train crash while making a Super 8 movie and soon suspect that it was not an accident.

programme.title: Cop Land
programme.desc: Director James Mangold (FORD vs FERRARI) extends his crime thriller classic that brings together a powerhouse cast, including Robert De Niro, Sylvester Stallone, Ray Liotta, and Harvey Keitel.

programme.title: Hollywood Homicide
programme.desc: A pair of detectives investigate a murder while pursuing their other full-time professions. Welcome to Hollywood Homicide - the only place where you can come to work hungry, horny, thirsty, and broke, and resolve all four by the end of the watch.

programme.title: Original Gangstas
programme.desc: A fast-paced Action-Thriller about adults living in a crime-ridden area. The are tired of being bullied, and take matters into their own hands to rid the town of the criminals.

programme.title: Bill & Ted's Bogus Journey
programme.desc: In this sequel to BILL & TED'S EXCELLENT ADVENTURE, the dimwitted duo travel to Heaven, Hell and points in between as they meet (among others) Albert Einstein, the Easter Bunny and the Grim Reaper.

programme.title: Bill & Ted Face the Music
programme.desc: Yet to fulfill their rock and roll destiny, the stakes are higher than ever for the now middle-aged Bill and Ted who set out on a new adventure when a visitor from the future warns them that only their song can save life as we know it.

programme.title: Rosencrantz and Guildenstern Are Dead
programme.desc: The filmization of Tom Stoppard's immensely witty Shakespearean spin-off, which changes the tone of Hamlet from a tragedy to a Comedy.

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October
programme.desc: A new technologically-superior Soviet nuclear sub is heading for the U.S. coast; however, one CIA analyst thinks the captain will defect the submarine, and he only has hours to prove it.

programme.title: The Saint
programme.desc: Want someone to infiltrate a top-secret organization or steal a scientific formula that could change the world? For the right price, The Saint is your man.

programme.title: First Knight
programme.desc: Together, Sean Connery, Richard Gere, Julia Ormond (Legends of the Fall, Sabrina) and Jerry Zucker, the director of Ghost, bring you a new vision of King Arthur's Camelot.

programme.title: King Kong (1976)
programme.desc: A petroleum exploration expedition comes to an isolated island and encounters a colossal giant gorilla.

programme.title: Mad Max
programme.desc: Max and the gang's worlds converge when the gang wants Max as badly as he wants them, especially after they target him for the death of their former leader.

programme.title: The Man Who Fell To Earth
programme.desc: Thomas Jerome Newton (David Bowie) is a humanoid alien who comes to Earth to get water for his dying planet. He starts a high technology company to get the billions of dollars he needs to build a return spacecraft.

programme.title: Moon
programme.desc: Sam Bell (Sam Rockwell) is nearing the completion of his 3-year-long contract with Lunar Industries, mining Earth's primary source of energy on the dark side of the moon.

programme.title: Ex Machina
programme.desc: A young programmer (Domhnall Gleeson) at an internet company is chosen by a reclusive CEO (Oscar Isaac) to evaluate the capabilities and consciousness of a beautiful and sophisticated robot (Alicia Vikander).

programme.title: Overlord
programme.desc: Nothing can prepare you for the mind-blowing mayhem that is Overlord. Mega producer J.J. Abrams creates an insanely twisted thrill ride about a team of American troops who come face-to-face with Nazi super-soldiers unlike the world has ever seen.

programme.title: Cold Mountain
programme.desc: A dramatic tale of love and survival set at the dawn of the Civil War. Nicole Kidman, Jude Law and Renée Zellweger star in Academy Award winning director Anthony Minghella's (THE ENGLISH PATIENT) captivating and poignant film.

programme.title: Chicago
programme.desc: Winner of 6 Academy Awards, including Best Picture, and based on the hit Broadway musical, Chicago is a dazzling spectacle cheered by audiences and critics alike, where crimes of passion make way for legends to those seeking the spotlight.

programme.title: Bridget Jones's Diary
programme.desc: Single girl Bridget Jones decides to turn over a new page in her life, channeling her thoughts, opinions, and insecurities into a diary. It's instead a hilarious chronicle of her adventures in this modern-romance classic based on the bestseller.

programme.title: Mindcage
programme.desc: When a copycat murderer strikes, Detectives Jake Doyle and Mary Kelly seek help from an incarcerated serial killer named the Artist. As Mary delves deep into the Artist's twisted psyche, she and Jake get lured into a diabolical game of cat and mouse.

programme.title: Manhunter
programme.desc: An ex-FBI sleuth (William Petersen) returns to psych out a full-moon ritual killer as only he can.

programme.title: Texas Killing Fields
programme.desc: After a familiar girl goes missing, two detectives race against time before a serial killer claims her as his next victim.

programme.title: Bill & Ted Face the Music
programme.desc: Yet to fulfill their rock and roll destiny, the stakes are higher than ever for the now middle-aged Bill and Ted who set out on a new adventure when a visitor from the future warns them that only their song can save life as we know it.

programme.title: Get Shorty
programme.desc: Golden Globe® winner John Travolta stars with Gene Hackman, Danny DeVito and Rene Russo in this wildly popular comedy of a gangster who turns into a big-time producer after he travels to Hollywood to collect a debt from a down-and-out filmmaker.

programme.title: Be Cool
programme.desc: John Travolta is back as Chili Palmer in this sequel to "Be Cool." With an all-star cast that includes Uma Thurman and The Rock, "Be Cool" is the hilarious tale about a gangster-turned-music-mogul...and what it takes to be number one with a bullet!

programme.title: Selma
programme.desc: From the Oscar-winning producers of 12 Years a Slave comes a powerful true story starring David Oyelewo and Oprah Winfrey. Facing violent opposition, Martin Luther King, Jr., led a historic march from Selma to Montgomery, changing the world forever.

programme.title: The Land
programme.desc: From Exec. Producer Nas. Music meets the mean streets in this tale of three friends looking to escape their lives in Cleveland. Starring Machine Gun Kelly and Erykah Badu.

programme.title: Out Of Sync
programme.desc: After he is released from prison, a former DJ tries to go straight and put his various vices behind him.

programme.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
programme.desc: The non-human machine ruling elite of the nuclear war-torn future has dispatched a cyborg assassin into the past to kill a young boy because he soon will be the resistance leader against the machines.

programme.title: Terminator Genisys
programme.desc: When John Connor sends Kyle Reese back to 1984 to protect a young Sarah Connor, unexpected events alter the past and threaten the future for all mankind. Charged with a new mission, Reese must join forces with Sarah and her "Guardian" to save the world.

programme.desc: A young programmer (Domhnall Gleeson) at an internet company is chosen by a reclusive CEO (Oscar Isaac) to evaluate the capabilities and consciousness of a beautiful and sophisticated robot (Alicia Vikander).

programme.title: Kingpin

programme.title: Autumn In New York

programme.title: It Had to Be You

programme.title: Kate & Leopold

programme.title: Jack Reacher

programme.title: Double Jeopardy
programme.desc: Libby Parsons, who discovers that the husband she’s convicted of murdering staged his own “death” and framed her for the crime. Released on parole, she skips town to find him–and that puts parole officer Travis Lehman on her trail.

programme.title: Disturbing Behavior

programme.title: The Fighter

programme.title: Eddie and the Cruisers
programme.desc: A reporter begins tracking down rumors of an unreleased album by a rock band whose charismatic leader disappeared after an accident and was presumed dead years before.

programme.title: Almost Famous

programme.title: Posse

programme.title: Quigley Down Under

programme.title: Cattle Annie And Little Britches

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: Crecer es peor que estornudar en tu periodo. De niño seguramente soñabas con crecer, pero para tu sorpresa, ahora solo sales al trabajo y al banco. En este episodio te traemos 6 sketches para que te desquites de las penas de la vida adulta. Dale play.

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: Si los superhéroes hubieran sido creados en Latinoamérica, tendrían verdaderos talentos como bajarse del bus al vuelo, esquivar chanclas de mamá y un sueño profundo inmune al camión de la chatarra. Dale play a este nuevo episodio.

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: Tal vez es momento de admitir que sí le robaste a tu mamá 5 dólares para comprarte una salchipapa, o que esas revistas inapropiadas que encontraron en tu casillero sí son tuyas. Tranquilo, no eres el único con secretos que contar. Dale play al episodio.

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: Imagina tener control z en una película de terror. Los protagonistas pagarían la luz a tiempo y no abrirían la puerta donde está el asesino, pero entonces no habría película. Disfruta estos sketches de miedo para que te mueras de la risa.

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: Existen situaciones peores que la muerte. Como andar de fiesta y descubrir 20 llamadas perdidas de tu mamá. Mira el episodio de hoy y disfruta con estas situaciones para morir de la risa.

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: Contrario a lo que muchos piensan, la vida sí es como en las películas. Pero una película de bajo presupuesto. Dale play al episodio y se le estrella de tu propio película... bueno el extra del fondo.

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: ¿Has pensado que pasaría si la realidad se mezclara con la ficción? Mira estos sketches y descúbrelo.

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: El secreto de la vida es saber mezclar. Hay mezclas clásicas pero también existen mezclas prohibidas como la pizza con piña, o vacilarte a tu prima. Las mezclas de hoy son igual de extrañas, pero te prometemos que van a sacarte una risa.

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: Hoy queremos ofrecerte un escape de la realidad. Dale un giro a la normalidad con estos 6 sketches y diviértete viendo como sería tu día a día si estuvieras dentro de una película. Y no, el nopor no cuenta como película. Dale play.

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: ¿Quieres identificar si eres la tóxica de tu relación? En este episodio repasaremos las diferentes etapas de los noviazgos. Sí ves a tu novio en algún sketch ¡sal de ahí amiga y date cuenta! Y si no, pues ya sabemos quién es el problema.

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: Si estás buscando la forma de terminar con tu novio, en este episodio te traemos algunas ideas. Dale play a estos 6 sketches y llénate de inspiración, eso sí, bajo tu propio riesgo.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Luego de ver una antigua foto de su niñez, Mr. Bean decide irse de campamento. Sin embargo el viaje desde la tienda hasta el campo se encuentra plagado de dificultades. Nada detendrá a Bean y a Teddy de disfrutar de las estrellas en el cielo nocturno.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Luego de que su modelo de avión fuera derribado por el de su pequeño rival, Mr. Bean construye uno nuevo para competir y tener su venganza. Con Teddy como piloto, la carrera comienza en el espacio aéreo de Londres.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr. Beans rompe su taza de té favorita, y se dirige a un lugar especial para encontrar otra taza de ese tipo. Allí luchará contra un pequeño canino que se ha robado a Teddy.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Hurgando en un viejo baúl en el ático de Mrs Wicket, Mr Bean nos transporta a su juventud. Allí nos develará cuando conoció a su fiel amigo Teddy y cuando aprendió a manejar su mini cooper. Su pasado fue lo que lo convirtió en el hombre que es ahora.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr. Bean adopta un misterioso animal rosado perdido. ¿Qué es esta cosa rosa y de dónde vino? Ninguna enciclopedia parece resolver el misterio sobre la identidad de la criatura. Mr Bean deberá insistir hasta encontrar una respuesta.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Irma Gobb tendrá una cena romántica junto a Mr. Bean, pero el no está del todo preparado. Al quedarse dormido en el baño mientras el pollo se cocina en el horno, Mr Bean debe ingeniárselas para tener lista la cena. Un invitado sorpresa tiene la solución.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Una pelota de tenis se atranca en una tubería de drenaje en la azotea. ¿De cuántas maneras diferentes puede Bean intentar recuperarla? Su único problema es el miedo a las alturas.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr Bean muerde un pedazo de palomitas de maíz, lo que le causa mucho dolor. Él piensa que al sacar su diente doloroso, resolverá sus problemas. Quitársela el mismo parece no dar solución y por eso deberá ir al dentista

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr. Bean salva a un gatito de un árbol. La prensa y el dueño del gatito llegan a su puerta para tomar una fotografía, pero el cabello de Bean está desordenado, por lo que decide cortarse el pelo."

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr Bean quiere ver un programa en la televisión, pero los vecinos no mantendrán el ruido bajo. No hay lugar en su casa para escapar de tan odioso sonido. Bean comienza a tener pensamientos de venganza.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Luego de un infortunado accidente, Mr Bean debe reemplazar al gato tuerto de su vecina. Sin embargo en sus reiterados intentos por limpiar el salón, Bean no encuentra manera de controlar al gato.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Ir a la tienda por provisiones se convierte en una pesadilla cuando una interminable lista de compras y un carrito aplastado con una rueda torcida conspiran para arruinar su día. Por lo que Mr. Bean decide construir un súper carrito de supermercado.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr Bean lleva a su casa una urraca herida y pronto se da cuenta de que le gusta coleccionar cosas brillantes que toma de las casas vecinas. Pero adivinen quién tiene la culpa...

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr.Bean imagina que está surfeando en Hawái, pero es interrumpido por su vecina. Por eso decide surfear por las escaleras en una tabla de planchar, lo que tiene consecuencias peligrosas. Con la Sra. Wicket en el hospital, Bean deberá cuidar de su gato

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr Bean pierde su barco embotellado, que queda atrapado en el camión del lechero. Lo busca de manera frenética, solo para verlo desaparecer en la lechería local, entre otras botellas. Una misión imposible.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Con Teddy en la tintorería, Mr Bean se siente solo. Por fortuna, aparece un pez dorado en el estanque del jardín. Bean se divierte mucho con su nuevo amigo hasta que, en la playa, descubre que algunos peces son gigantescos y tienen grandes dientes.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Un mecánico estafa a Mr Bean. Le hace creer que su auto no tiene reparación y que tiene que llevarse a la trituradora. Mr Bean decide construir un globo aerostático y desde el aire descubre al mecánico paseando con su auto.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Durante una visita a la Galería Nacional de Londres, Mr Bean es testigo del robo de una importante obra de arte. Sabueso que es, persigue al culpable a través del Canal hacia París. Le esperan muchos obstáculos.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr. Bean va al cine a ver algunas películas de terror, pero las cosas se vuelven locas cuando se asusta hasta el hueso. Su imaginación le juega una mala pasada. Todo una pesadilla.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr Bean e Irma Gobb salen en una cita. Todo marcha muy bien; una película romántica y una cena a la luz de las velas. Pero no todo es perfecto. Bean olvida su billetera y la obliga a pagar todo.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.desc: Kawajiri logra matar a Hayato. Al enterarse del asesinato, Rohan y el resto van a inspeccionar la casa de Kawajiri. La flecha de Yoshihiro perfora a Kawajiri.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: Cae una bomba en la casa donde se esconden Josuke y Hayato. Ninguno de los dos logra adivinar cómo el proyectil pudo detectarlos.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: Con el Stand más adecuado para la tarea, Koichi Hirose llega a Nápoles para localizar al joven Haruno Shiobana, un hombre del que se teme que sea hijo de Dio Brando.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: La vida de Giorno, un niño abandonado, cambia cuando ayuda a un mafioso a evitar la muerte. Giorno aprende más sobre sus poderes mientras se enfrenta a Bruno Bucciarati.

programme.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
programme.desc: Decidido a unirse al grupo mafioso Passione, Giorno visita a Polpo, un miembro importante, en prisión, donde se le somete a una prueba de iniciación imposible.

programme.title: Heidi: El fantasma
programme.desc: Heidi no puede dormir, extraña su vida en las montañas. Todos en la casa piensan que se trata de un fantasma pero en realidad es Heidi que extraña su vida anterior. Clara invita al abuelo a pasar unos días en Frankfurt.

programme.title: Heidi: La carta
programme.desc: Heidi se enferma al enterarse de que su tía nunca le mando la carta al abuelo, Clara está angustiada y pide que dejen a Heidi regresar a las montañas. Finalmente Heidi irá de regreso y mandan la carta pero la carta se pierde en el camino.

programme.title: Heidi: De regreso en Dörfli
programme.desc: Heidi toma el tren de vuelta a las montañas, el abuelo no recibe la carta y emprende un viaje a Mayenfeld, Heidi hará todo lo posible para llegar con su abuelo y pedirle que regrese a las montañas.

programme.title: Heidi: Una nueva cabra en el rebaño
programme.desc: Heidi esta feliz de regresar de nuevo a la montaña con Pedro y las cabras. Karl se mete en un problema y Pedro tiene que acudir a su rescate, Heidi se queda sola con las cabras con la sorpresa de que la cabra embarazada esta a punto de dar a luz.

programme.title: Heidi: La estatua rota
programme.desc: Heidi y el abuelo se mudan a la mansión para que Heidi pueda continuar sus estudios. Los Keller se enojan por esta situación y se niegan a venderle suministros al abuelo.

programme.title: Heidi: El prendedor
programme.desc: Pedro y su abuela no tienen suficiente dinero, Heidi encuentra el broche de su abuela, una reliquia que los puede ayudar a salir de este problema.

programme.title: Heidi: Prueba escolar
programme.desc: El profesor organizar una prueba para finalizar el periodo, Theresa esta celosa de que Heidi esta ayudando a Pedro a ser buen estudiante, en venganza abre el recinto de las cabras para que Pedro no pueda llegar a la prueba a tiempo.

programme.title: Heidi: La búsqueda del tesoro
programme.desc: El Sr Traber se mudará a otra ciudad pero se lleva consigo a Karl, Theresa tiene sentimientos por él. Heidi la empujara a que confiese sus sentimientos por el antes de que se vaya.

programme.title: Heidi: La hora de las cabras
programme.desc: Por fin llega Clara y la señorita Rottenmeier a visitar a Heidi, Clara y Heidi quieren pasar el mayor tiempo juntas por lo que deben convencer a la señorita Rottenmeier de que vivan juntos en las cabañas en la montaña.

programme.title: Heidi: La tormenta
programme.desc: Todos están viviendo en la cabaña, un día de tormenta la señorita Rottenmeier se pierde entre las montañas, todos se preocupan por ella y salen a su búsqueda, sin pensar que la señorita Rottemeier regresará a salvo.

programme.title: Naruto: La partida

programme.title: Baloise Session
programme.desc: Los íconos de la música británica Duran Duran regresan a Suiza con sus décadas de innovación musical y una nueva energía creativa.

programme.title: Other Voices
programme.desc: La iglesia de St James está a rebosar de entusiasmo por las sesiones de Murder Capital, ØXN y Julie Byrne. Mientras tanto, KhakiKid debuta en la IMRO Other Room en nuestro nuevo espacio WAVE.

programme.title: Memory Lane
programme.desc: Esta es una serie que mira tanto hacia atrás como hacia adelante a partir de las presentaciones en vivo, señalando la evolución de un artista. Las canciones representan tanto sus vidas como su trabajo y crean el marco para una película biográfica.

programme.title: Billy Idol: In Super Overdrive Live
programme.desc: El rockero famoso Billy Idol se junta con el guitarrista Steve Stevens para interpretar sus canciones más reconocidas, entre ellas "White Wedding" y "Overdrive." Desde Congress Theater en Texas, EE. UU.

programme.title: El Asalto
programme.desc: Una joven policía, da suministros a los rehenes, uno de los cuatro ladrones está enfermo y necesita insulina. El Comisionado acepta darle una dosis a cambio de un rehén. En el sótano, dos cómplices perforan una pared que da acceso a la bóveda.

programme.title: El Asalto
programme.desc: Alex accede a la bóveda, y a un botín de ocho millones de euros. Los rehenes siguen atados con sus ojos vendados. Los ladrones se preparan para evacuar el banco a través de los sótanos.

programme.title: El Cazador
programme.desc: A principios del siglo XX, un excombatiente bóer llega a Nueva Zelanda, y allí se le ofrece el trabajo de rastrear a un maorí acusado falsamente de asesinar a un oficial británico.

programme.title: Gunman
programme.desc: Jim Terrier es una espía internacional que ha sido traicionado por la organización para la que trabajaba. Debido a ello decide dejar atrás su antigua vida de agente encubierto para casarse con su novia Annie y mudarse a otro estado.

programme.title: Epic Movie
programme.desc: Esta producción satírica presenta a un grupo de huérfanos que se embarca en diversas aventuras.

programme.title: Austin Powers - Súper Agente
programme.desc: Un agente secreto de los años sesenta es sacado a la luz en los años noventa.

programme.title: Las Voces
programme.desc: Jerry es un tipo alegre que trabaja en una fabrica de bañeras y tiene un encanto poco convencional. Con la ayuda de su psiquiatra, golpea a un compañero de trabajo. Pero la relacion toma un giro inesperado y asesino despues de que ella lo invita a salir.

programme.title: La Maldicion de la Novia
programme.desc: Tras la muerte de su padre, Alyson, su pareja Richard y su bebé regresan a la casa de su infancia. Tras una serie de impactantes sucesos sobrenaturales, Alyson descubre que ella y su familia han estado viviendo bajo una terrible maldición.

programme.title: Terror en el Bosque
programme.desc: Después de que una excursión familiar de campamento se convierte en una pesadilla, una madre debe luchar para salvar a su familia de un terrateniente enfurecido que esconde un terrible secreto en su propiedad.

programme.title: La Conspiración del Diablo
programme.desc: Una secta satánica roba el sudario de Turín para obtener el ADN de Jesucristo y, de esta forma, ofrecérselo al señor de las tinieblas. Sin embargo, el arcángel Miguel desciende a la Tierra para evitar que el mal triunfe.

programme.title: Fight Club
programme.desc: Un hombre deprimido conoce a un fabricante de jabones, y juntos forman un club de pelea clandestino que evoluciona en algo inesperado.

programme.title: Falsa Identidad
programme.desc: James Franco y Jonah Hill protagonizan este tenso thriller sobre un hombre acusado de asesinar a toda su familia y el desacreditado reportero de periódico que afirma ser, hasta que es capturado.

programme.title: El Amante
programme.desc: Un hombre que, tras la muerte de su esposa, descubre que ésta había tenido un amante durante varios años, se embarca en un viaje para encontrar al amante de su mujer y descubrir toda la verdad de esa relación.

programme.title: Bajo el Mismo Cielo
programme.desc: Un célebre contratista militar regresa al escenario de los mayores triunfos de su carrera y se reencuentra con un antiguo amor, al tiempo que se enamora inesperadamente de la enérgica supervisora de la Fuerza Aérea que le ha sido asignada.

programme.title: Travesuras de una Princesa
programme.desc: La «primera hija» busca una experiencia universitaria normal, pero los peligros inherentes a su título la persiguen. Por ello, el Servicio Secreto asigna a un joven agente encubierto para vigilarla.

programme.title: Rambo 4
programme.desc: El veterano de Vietnam John Rambo ha sobrevivido a muchas pruebas terribles en su vida y desde entonces se ha retirado a una existencia simple y aislada en Tailandia, donde pasa su tiempo capturando serpientes para artistas locales.

programme.title: Un hombre extraordinario
programme.desc: Una aldea espera con ilusión la llegada de un hacedor de milagros. Pero el humilde viajero que aparece no es lo que esperaban. Sin embargo, los milagros pueden ocurrir en todas sus formas y tamaños.

programme.title: Meet Dave
programme.desc: Una nave espacial con forma humana tiene 48 horas para recuperar el orbe y arrojarlo al océano.

programme.title: Mi “Querido” Elfo
programme.desc: Una madre soltera compra un piso antiguo, sin saber que una criatura mítica -un elfo doméstico- lleva siglos viviendo en él.

programme.title: Vacaciones En The Hamptons
programme.desc: Ni el tiempo ni la distancia pueden apagar por completo las chispas del primer amor. Cuando Jade Lewis regresa a la casa de su abuelo en los Hamptons, se reencuentra con el amor de su infancia.

programme.title: Christmas Chalet, The
programme.desc: Una amante de la Navidad y divorciada reserva un viaje a un chalet con su madre y su hija. Sin embargo, el mismo chalet está reservado para un único escritor que odia la Navidad. Juntos aprenden la magia de la Navidad y la familia.

programme.title: Vacaciones En The Hamptons
programme.desc: Ni el tiempo ni la distancia pueden apagar por completo las chispas del primer amor. Cuando Jade Lewis regresa a la casa de su abuelo en los Hamptons, se reencuentra con el amor de su infancia.

programme.title: Bajo el Mismo Cielo

programme.title: Una cenicienta de moda
programme.desc: El sueño de Kate es diseñar para las casas de alta costura. A pesar de que es una joven con un brillante talento, Kate no puede conseguir un trabajo. Y es que nadie confía en lahijade Lee Kassell, un minorista que comercializa diseños de baja calidad.

programme.title: Just My Luck
programme.desc: Ashley, una mujer muy afortunada, cambia su suerte con el desdichado Jake.

programme.title: Crimen Paranormal
programme.desc: Una pareja que está de viaje en coche a Las Vegas rescata a un misterioso superviviente de un aparente atropello. Pero su decisión de recoger al hombre acabarán lamentándola cuando este les obligue a hacer lo impensable

programme.title: Secretos de un crimen
programme.desc: Una detective busca desentrañar un misterio que rodea a niños desaparecidos y donde los principales sospechosos son dos mujeres jóvenes que, hace siete años, fueron encerradas por la muerte de un bebé.

programme.title: Evidencia
programme.desc: Un detective persigue a un asesino utilizando imágenes de video filmadas por las víctimas de una masacre en una estación de servicio abandonada.

programme.title: Soy Familia Soy Michoacano
programme.desc: Una tragedia que marcara la vida de la Familia Michoacana, los obligara a cobrar venganza por su propia mano, sin esperar la terrible sorpresa que les espera el destino. Una Película llena de Acción, drama, y suspenso rodeada de traiciones y desgracias.

programme.title: Soy el Hijo del Tahúr

programme.title: Mi obsesión por los motores

programme.title: Mi obsesión por los motores
programme.desc: Cuando Charles y Trey enganchan un Ford Maverick Grabber de 1970 junto con auto en piezas, aportan algo un poco más personal.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT
programme.desc: Arnold pierde las invitaciones de la fiesta de cumpleaños de Eugene y nadie asiste, pero luego que Arnold le organiza una segunda fiesta y también fracasa. / Stinky decide probar suerte con la jardinería.

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT
programme.desc: Helga gana una cena para cuatro personas y decide llevar a Phoebe para que ella lleve a Gerald y a su mejor amigo. / Phoebe es promovida al sexto grado, y Helga tiene problemas buscando una compañera.

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT
programme.desc: Harold, Sid y Stinky le hacen una broma de muy mal gusto al Director Wartz. / Olga viene de visita otra vez, y es la nueva ayudante del Profesor Simmons.

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT
programme.desc: Para pagar su deuda con el Gran Gino, Sid deberá trabajar para él. / Cuando Jamie O, el hermano de Gerald, se enamora de una chica, Gerald por fin tiene un hermano que lo trata bien.

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT
programme.desc: Miriam reemplaza a Bob en su trabajo, pero comienza a distanciarse más de lo normal de Helga. / Oskar, quien nunca aprendió a leer, le pide a Arnold que le enseñe.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Después de haber oído rumores acerca de la supervivencia de Maestros Aire, los niños viajan al Templo del Norte para verlos. Lo que encuentran allí podría significar un desastre para todos los enemigos de la Nación de Fuego.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Los niños llegan a la tribu Norte del Agua, donde Aang y Katara buscan a un Maestro de Agua. Mientras, Sokka se enamora de una princesa. Zhao planea un ataque y Zuko debe encontrar una manera de continuar su búsqueda del Avatar.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: La Tribu Agua del Norte se prepara para el ataque de la flota de la Nación del Fuego, comandada por el almirante Zhao. Aang lucha para defender la ciudad y se pregunta si no hay una mejor manera de utilizar sus habilidades de Avatar.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: La invasión de Zhao traspasa el muro defensivo de la Tribu Agua del Norte y revela su plan siniestro. Aang se va al Mundo de los Espíritus en busca de ayuda, pero ¿volverá a tiempo para detener a Zhao?

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Aang y el grupo se reúnen con un general del Reino de la Tierra que quiere usar el poderoso "Estado Avatar" de Aang como un arma para derrotar a la Nación del Fuego.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: En su camino a Omashu, los niños conocen a un grupo de nómadas que les muestran un atajo a través de la "Cueva de los Enamorados". Pero cuando se pierden,deben confiar en el amor para superar la maldición y escapar de los túneles

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Los niños vuelven a Omashu para que Aang pueda aprender del Rey Bumi a controlar la tierra. Pero cuando llegan allí, se sorprenden al descubrir que ahora, la ciudad está en manos de la Nación del Fuego.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Aang y sus amigos descubren un pueblo que celebra el "Día del Avatar". Pero cuando descubren que es un festival anti-Avatar causado por algo que hizo Aang en su pasado, Aang decide limpiar el nombre del Avatar.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Fierecilla

programme.title: Armados y peligrosos

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager
programme.desc: Neelix se resiste a decirle a Naomi que su madre y otros han desaparecido en una misión.

programme.title: Hielo

programme.desc: Giorno y Mista llegan a Venecia para recuperar el disco de datos, pero el Stand White Ice de Ghiaccio frustra su misión congelando todo lo que tienen a la vista.

programme.title: La Abeja Maya

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Si bien es el gran día de la cosecha de polen, Maya y Willy por error han puesto ha dormir toda la colmena. Ahora tienen que pedirles a todos sus amigos que les ayuden con la cosecha de algas, una flor que florece sólo un día al año.

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Un grillo evita que todo el prado duerma. Maya y Willy lo buscarán. Chris, el grillo, sólo está tratando de invitar a Lila la señora de cricket para ir a la pelota, pero él le envía el mensaje equivocado!

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Mientras juegan, Maya y Willy accidentalmente destruyen la casa de un pequeño gusano de frutas. Maya quiere ayudarlo a encontrar un nuevo lugar tranquilo

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Maya tiene dificultades para aprender el baile de las abejas, muy útil para moverse a las direcciones correctas. Flip tratará de ayudarla y gracias a sus lecciones, Maya podrá mostrar a la abeja trabajadora principal un nuevo campo de flores

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: A través de una combinación de circunstancias, Willy se convierte en el rey muy mimado de un pulgón perdido escuchado. Pero cuando los pulgones realmente necesitan a su "rey" para protegerlos, Willy necesitará la ayuda de Maya.

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Maya y Willy cruzan el bosque para ver una flor muy rara, la flor de luna, pero quedan atrapados por la noche y se pierden. Por suerte, pueden contar con una luciérnaga para ayudar a encontrar el camino de regreso

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Maya ha mojado accidentalmente las alas de Beatrice. Ha perdido algo de su pólvora y ya no puede volar. Maya tiene que encontrar una solución para ayudarla, ya que la gran bola de mariposa se acerca rápidamente

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Harto del protocolo pesado, la Reina decide dejar la colmena por un momento para visitar el prado. Ella conoce a Maya que está encantada de hacer que la Reina descubra su universo. Pero sin la Reina, la colmena se acerca al caos

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Una mosca ha robado la pelota de Ben para usarla como nido para poner sus huevos. Por desgracia, es la pelota que Ben quería mostrar en la gran reunión de escarabajos! Maya y Willy deciden ayudar a Ben a hacer una nueva pelota

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Los primos de Flip llegan al prado. Cuando están todos juntos, extrañamente cambian su color y su comportamiento. Como Flip también está cambiando, Maya se da cuenta de que podría perder a su amigo. ¡Ella hará cualquier cosa para recuperarlo!

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Maya y Willy han atrapado varroas, una especie de piojos de abeja. La colmena está infectada. Deciden pedir a las abejas silvestres del bosque consejos sobre cómo deshacerse de estos parásitos

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Mientras juegan, Maya y Willy rompen el caparazón de Shelby por error. Tienen que encontrar una manera de reparar la grieta antes de que se ponga peligroso para su amigo.

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Maya quiere ayudar al Escarabajo de la señorita Rosie, una anciana que perdió su casa durante una tormenta. Ella quiere encontrar a su hermano que vive en un viejo árbol al otro lado del estanque.

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: El Juez Beeswax está visitando la colmena. Es testigo de un accidente causado por Maya. Decide establecer una licencia de vuelo. Ahora las abejas tienen que permanecer en el suelo y no pueden hacer su trabajo correctamente

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Maya conoce a una linda peluca que es un verdadero artista y esculpe todo lo que ve. Pero su arte es malinterpretado por los otros que tienden a rechazarlo. Maya le ayudará a ser aceptado por la comunidad

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Maya juega con pequeñas chinches. Pronto se da cuenta de que están solas y trata de encontrar a su madre. Ella descubre que la madre está desesperada por darles de comer.

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
